notes.title: New Gun, Loadouts, Anti-Cheat Changes
notes.notes:
New Gun: SMG
The SMG is a high firerate, medium damage weapon. It excels at mid-range fighting, but is less effective at long distances due to the spread increase with sustained firing (tap fire at long range for best accuracy!). You can equip it in the new loadouts menu at level 15 or higher.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/125c1bea619a02c69f7750920c3dad274b306fb2.gif"]

Base Stats

Pull out time: 0.4s

Firerate: 18.16/s

Reload time: 1s

Magazine size: 40

Damage: 16

All of the stats are subject to change as I balance the gun with player feedback!


Loadouts
To accommodate new weapons, loadouts have been added. Pick any 3 guns to use in a loadout! You can have as many loadouts as you want, and switch between them in the main menu or in the escape menu during a match.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/c6b6d31694e14df4ae3294239772ff72fb2c1a93.gif"]


Anti-Cheat
You guys had a lot of feedback about the new Enforcer Anti-Cheat that was created for Redmatch 2. We've removed it from the game for now while we look into performance issues and potentially Proton support. Thanks for your patience!


All Changes
Added SMG

Added loadouts

Fixed an issue where the revolver would display the sniper sight on other players' clients

Added revolver reload sound

Optimizations to player animation syncing

notes.title: Anti-Cheat Update!
notes.notes:
Custom Anti-Cheat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/15444a87b1e8d734bde2ce9daeb4dfd6843b5979.png"]

I've heard your complaints loud and clear about the cheater problem, so I've been working closely with another developer for the past 5 months to bring a custom Anti-Cheat (Enforcer) to Redmatch 2.

Please bear with us as we fix bugs and issues while we roll it out fully! This is the first time this Anti-Cheat has been used in a game, as it was created for Redmatch 2. If you encounter any issues with the Anti-Cheat, please contact me or the Anti-Cheat developer (@Lewis) on our Discord server so that we can quickly work to fix them.


FAQ
Is it a kernel Anti-Cheat?

It is not kernel level, and operates in user-mode.

Does it impact performance?

We aim to have minimal to no impact on performance. We've held many beta tests before the public release to smooth out as many issues as possible. If you encounter performance issues, please report them to the Anti-Cheat developer (@Lewis) on our Discord server and we'll work to fix them. 

What about platforms other than 64 bit Windows?

Redmatch 2 doesn't officially support any platforms except 64 bit Windows. However, I recognize that people play the game on Linux using Proton. The Anti-Cheat is not guaranteed to work with Proton, but if you are unable to use it you will still be able to create and join matches not protected by the Anti-Cheat.

Why can't you just do server-side checks for cheating? 

Redmatch 2 is a peer to peer game, which makes server side checks inherently difficult. However, Redmatch 2 already has clients validate each other based on various suspicion metrics, and automatically remove players from matches when they reach a certain threshold. As we've seen from the issues the game still has with cheaters, this isn't enough. A client-side anti cheat is necessary to bring the cheating issues to a minimum.

notes.title: Voice Chat Update!
notes.notes:
Hello folks! I'm back with some big changes and a ton of bugfixes.
Voice Chat
I've always felt that the communication in Redmatch 2 has been a bit lacking, so I've worked the past few months on getting voice chat working in-game. The default mode is Global, and you can enable Proximity Chat in match settings (which is especially fun for Infection!). You can use either push-to-talk or open mic, and individually adjust player volumes in the escape menu. If you encounter players abusing the voice chat feature, please report them and the moderation team will investigate. Voice chat can be deactivated completely if you don't want to use it.


Chat Translation
If you click a message in chat and choose "Translate" you can now translate it into your current game language using DeepL's free translation service. You'll need to set up a DeepL account to use this. The full instructions are in-game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/afeb65a6574da97b79c4f61792ac2d7156fe3952.gif"]


Improved Player Reporting
To report a player, click them on the scoreboard, on a chat message, or in the escape menu in the player voice chat list, and choose "Report."

The player reporting system in Redmatch 2 has always been lackluster. Previously reporting players did not do anything, and just told you in chat to report players on the Discord server. Now, reporting players in-game provides you with several options which will report the player directly to our moderation team. For evidence of hacking, you will still need to join the Discord to upload photo/video evidence, but reporting them in-game will help us identify hackers more quickly. There are no automated actions based on reports, so don't worry about getting report spammed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/9944b70cb1936a5a0033f460bda9e01c4f989190.png"]
Full Update Notes
Changes

Added Voice Chat.

You can now copy the content of messages sent in chat by right clicking them.

Added an in-game report feature. For evidence of hacking, you will still need to join the Discord to upload photo/video evidence. However, this makes reporting text or voice chat much easier, and it will be easier for moderators to quickly react to reports.

Added an appeals system. If you believe you were wrongfully muted, banned from the game, or banned from using custom skins or banners, you can now appeal here.

Added chat translation.

Completely overhauled the UI for the settings menu to match the rest of the game.

When you get a kill, the name will show up at the top of your personall killfeed instead of the bottom, which will prevent kill text from appearing off screen.

Minimum FPS is now 30 instead of 3.

Increased max physics tickrate to 300. Making this setting higher will make gameplay smoother on high refresh rate monitors.

You can now adjust the volume of custom maps independently from normal game audio. This is useful for cases where custom maps have their own music or sound effects.

Adjusted the way volume sliders work to be more consistent with expectations.

You will now be able to see if a player has been muted while in the main menu lobby next to their username, and it is faster to display mute status changes on the scoreboard.

The host icon has been replaced with a crown.

Added a VSync setting.

Improved the way commands work to provide more descriptive error messages. Use /help to see all available commands.

Bugfixes

Fixed a bug where failing to vote to ban would sometimes display the wrong error message (low level instead of cooldown).

Chat and vote bans no longer appear over the escape menu.

Fixed a clipping issue with chat when there was only 1 message present.

Improved how achievements save progress, so players who were unable to progress on Workplace Catastrophe, etc. should no longer have issues. Unfortunately this means any existing progress on these achievements will be reset.

Fixed a bug where scoped mouse sensitivity would affect the sensitivity of the sniper even when not using the telescopic scope.

Fixed a bug where sometimes a notification message of every ban ever made would be sent to the chat.

The game will show an error message when it fails to connect to Steam instead of crashing.

The chat rate limit is no longer affected by the slow motion at the end of a match.

Fixed a bug where you could not earn achievements on custom maps.

Fixed a bug where spamming a match setting as the match started would allow you to override a custom map's forced match setting.

Make sure to join the Discord server to talk to other Redmatch 2 players or if you want to see live updates of my progress for future updates!

Join the Discord Server

1.32.1 (April 5)

The Chainsaw hat will now have the spike speed affected by the slowdown at the end of a match
The vote ban settings can now be changed by me remotely so that I can tweak values without updating the game.
Reduced stuttering in the main menu caused by frequent checking of download progress and display of completion percentage for workshop items. More subscribed workshop items leads to more stuttering during the first few seconds after the menu loads due to numerous callbacks on download status from Steam. I might consider optimizing it later, but currently, it only affects players with more than a couple Resource Pack subscriptions and has minimal impact. Mostly this has just resulted in the realization that Steam callbacks are fairly expensive and should be used more sparingly.

Added a new loading screen by Gilikosik
Improved the icon alignment on the scoreboard UI


1.31.3 (February 24)

Infected players no longer get spawn protection
Fixed a bug where in Team gamemodes you wouldn't get damaged the acid on Xeo
Attempted another fix for the match instantly ending when the host started as Infected


1.31.2 (February 23)

Fixed a bug where if a player lost connection and everyone got infected, Survivors would win
(Hopefully) fixed a bug where if the Host of the match got infected at the start the match would instantly end


1.31.1 (February 23)

Fixed a bug where the last survivor leaving could cause the match to go on forever
Fixed a bug where if any player hadn't been assigned to Survivor or Infected (still loading in) the match could go on forever
Fixed a bug where the infected objective would not display if you joined the match late
Fixed a bug created in 1.31.0 where all the settings were lowercase and not translated
Survivors no longer have grapple gear (by default) in Infection
Added new match settings for infection: Survivor Grapple Gear and Infected Bonus Health

notes.title: Update 1.30 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.30.14 (February 10)

Fixed a bug where any time you tried to join a friend's match through the Steam friends list you would get a "Failed to join match. Incompatible match version" error


1.30.13 (February 8)

I reordered the patch notes so the newer patches are first. I think it will make it easier to see the newest changes.
Tweaked a secret area on Ruins
Added a setting for using mouse input on upgrade cabinets, so you don't have to use the mouse if you liked the old system
You can no longer join matches with an incompatible version through the Join Lobby feature on the Steam friends list
Fixed text clipping issues with matches on the match list that had an incompatible version
Added basic censorship for match names
Matches in the match list will now update the gamemode property when it's changed in the match
Fixed a bug I introduced in the last patch where you could use Upgrade Cabinets when they were disabled


1.30.12 (February 5)

Added team spawns to Arena
Added team spawns to Outskirts
Added an Italian translation for the "Hide Private" toggle
Fixed a bug with the Speed Demon achievement where if you hadn't played any of the time trials yet, it would give you the achievement on your first gold.
Increased the maximum amount of concurrent matches.
Fixed a bug where the saw hat would be visible in first person view
Fixed a bug where you could move around while using an Upgrade Cabinet
Improved the UI for Upgrade Cabinets
If you are aiming and interact with an Upgrade Cabinet, you will now stop aiming
The crosshair will now hide when interacting with Upgrade Cabinets
You can now click options to upgrade in Upgrade Cabinets instead of having to use the keyboard
Gravity will now respond to dynamic match setting updates


1.30.11 (January 30)

Votes now require 60% match participation to pass
Added reasons to vote bans: Hacking, Toxicity, and Being Too Good. We'll see if I keep that last one in or not.
Fixed a bug where interacting with an upgrade cabinet would send every single player to the world origin on your screen (this was especially visible at one upgrade cabinet by the world origin on the map Sticks)
Fixed a bug where closing the chat window while in the Team Deathmatch team select menu would hide your cursor and make you unable to join a team
Fixed a bug where if you were typing in chat when the map loaded then it would deselect the chat input and you would have to click it again to continue typing
Adjusted the positions of some upgrade cabinets on Orbit which were sunken into the ground
Changed the loading screen


1.30.10 (January 28)

Added localization for the "Join Team" button
Reworked the language selection menu UI
Reworked the private match password menu
Added a popup notice when you try to join a full match
Added requirements to RPC execution
Fixed some internal issues with animation layers


1.30.9 (January 23)

Reworked Find Match and Match Settings menus
Renamed Room Settings to Match Settings
Fixed missing characters in the Japanese translation
Votes now require 55% match participation to pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/eaa4fbc7778f0f33f101c342329552f0d9e0d9c8.png

1.30.8 (January 20)

Votes now require 75% match participation to pass
Votes now require a 80% yes to pass


1.30.7 (January 19)

Improved vote ban chat responses to clarify why a ban failed


1.30.6 (January 19)

Increased the cooldown between starting a vote from 60 seconds to 240 seconds
Increased the time you have to wait after joining a match to start a vote from 15 seconds to 120 seconds.
Votes now require a 75% yes to pass
Votes now require 60% match participation to pass
You can no longer start a vote to ban moderators
You can no longer start a vote while another vote is in progress
Votes are no longer anonymous


1.30.5 (January 18)

Fixed a bug with the Slice death effect not having its physics simulate correctly when it was being previewed at a specific rotation in the customization menu
Removed the restriction that custom skins must first be uploaded to ibb.co or imgur.com. You can now use any image URL, depending on the permissions of the website.
Custom skins can now be rotated in-game so that you don't have to keep uploading a skin to get the front of the image aligned to the front of the player
Changed the way host bans work. Hosts no longer get complete ban control. You can now only have complete ban control if you're the host and creator of the match. Anyone can vote to ban anyone else. there's a 15 second vote, and if 50% of players in the match vote with a 50% vote yes to ban, the player will be banned. There's a 60 second time limit between when players can start a vote.


1.30.4 (January 15)

Fixed a text clipping issue in the Resource Packs menu for Resource Packs with long names
Moderators can now change the names of matches if they are inappropriate
Fixed an issue with the mouse scroll not looping around through items
Matches created on the beta branch will now have a [Beta] tag to make it more clear why they are a newer version


1.30.3 (January 13)

Fixed the Jack-O'-Lantern hat not being available to players who owned it
Added a fancy new loading spinner
Changed the default name of a match from "Username's Room" to "Username's Match"
Changed how ownership verification of DLC works


1.30.2 (December 26)

Ended the daily present event
Updated new achievement translations


1.30.1 (December 25)

Made the achievements menu look a lot nicer
Stats will now sync to Steam every 3 minutes as well as when the game is closed (could have potentially fixed the weird cloud save not matching issues)
Added a locked icon for the achievement Good Sport
Unlocking an achievement while in the menu will now update the achievement menu UI

notes.title: Update 1.29 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.29.0 (December 14)

Fixed the "buy" text on the upgrade cabinets not being translated (broken in a previous update)
You can no longer create custom skins while muted (even though you couldn't use them)
Removed the waistband from the grapple gear since it just covered skins
Fixed a bug where you could use rich text tags in your steam name to change the color of text
Fixed an exploit on Metro where you could glitch inside a wall
Fixed the googly eyes not spinning around when you rotated the character in the main menu
Fixed the Game Over death rotating 90 degrees when viewed through a sniper scope
Typing "/" in the main menu no longer opens the chat (this was very annoying when typing skin URLs)


1.29.1 (December 15)

Added a "Sell on Community Market" button to items received from presents to make the process more clear.


1.29.2 (December 15)

Added a blue variant to the Horns hat (reunited at last!) and a black variant to the Shuriken hat


1.29.3 (December 15)

Reduced the present timer from 24 hours to 20 hours.

notes.title: Update 1.28 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.28.1 (November 13)

Steam friends will now have green names on the team select screen


1.28.2 (November 24)

Completely redesigned the Customization menu
Hats have been separated into 2 categories: Hats and Faces. Now you can equip the googly eyes and the top hat at the same time, for example.
The background of the weapons customization screen is now a bright blue sky instead of the dark dreary night
Fixed a graphical issue with the Laser death effect where it would appear to shrink for a few frames before slicing apart
Shrank the Determination death effect
Shrank the Rings death effect and improved its graphics
Fixed the weird black shadow that was left behind after the player dissolved during the Drone death effect
Fixed the scaling of different death effects
Fixed some texture stretching issues on the inside of the player in the Laser death effect
Fixed some funky shadows in the Confetti death effect


1.28.3 (November 25)

Fixed some minor bugs with the customization menu


1.28.4 & 1.28.5 (November 27)

Re-released 1.28.3 with a debug message to try to fix the issue where the customization menu wouldn't render any buttons


1.28.6 (November 27)

Fixed the issue where the customization menu wouldn't render any buttons


1.28.7 (November 28)

Added better moderation tools for custom skins


1.28.8 (November 29)

You can no longer add custom skins that don't end in a .png, .jpg, or .jpeg (URLs could end in other file extensions, but just wouldn't work)


1.28.9 (November 30)

You can now delete custom skins (right click them)


1.28.10 (November 30)

Fixed a bug where custom skins would disappear after joining and leaving a match


1.28.11 (December 2)

Players will no longer have empty hands when you join a game late before they switch weapons or die
Anti-Cheat tweaks
Fixed some ? profile pictures for players who join the game late

notes.title: Update 1.27 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Every time I edit an event, Steam re-publishes it to the library page, which is kind of annoying. So I'm going to move all patch notes for updates to a separate post, like this one.

1.27.1-1.27.4 were just hotfixes to fix some bugs with the new update, and add the advertisement for the new bundle in the main menu

1.27.5 (November 1)

Fixed the cut off text in the context menu with custom Resource Pack fonts
Added bullet_hole to the Resource Pack documentation
Added wrapMode and filterMode to the Image category in the Resource Pack documentation
You can now set the thumbnail for your Resource Pack to a gif, by using thumb.gif instead of thumb.png
The "No Resource Packs found" text will no longer appear if you delete all Resource Packs but still have Local Resource Packs
You can now scroll the Resource Pack list while dragging a Resource Pack
Resource Packs now make that clicky UI sound when you drag them around
Fixed audio in the main menu not resetting properly when you removed a Resource Pack


1.27.6 (November 1)

Added a shiny animation to the loading bar when downloading a Resource Pack
Added a metadata.json file to Resource Packs for making a custom title when you want a title with characters not supported by Windows folders


1.27.7 (November 5)

Made the input fields next to sliders much easier to type in (they won't reset to a value inside the bounds while you're typing now)
Fixed some UI that wasn't being affected by Resource Packs
Updated the Streets platinum rank time trial with my new best time
Fixed an issue where if you had too many time trial entries you wouldn't be able to edit Resource Packs
Reduced the spawn protection time from 2 seconds to 1.3 seconds
Melee will now cancel spawn protection
Redmatch 2 has a feature where you can see which matches your friends are in with a green dot. There was a bug where blocked friends and people who sent you a friend request would also make the dot appear, which is now fixed.


1.27.8 (November 5)

You can now right click a Resource Pack to copy its install path
Updated the 32 bit build of the game

notes.title: Lots of bugfixes! - Update 1.23
notes.notes:
Changes

Added a melee damage multiplier
Added wind audio which plays when you move fast
Added weapon sway to mouse movement. It turns off when aiming.
Switched from a linear audio scale to logarithmic, so you won't hear far away sounds as loudly.
Replaced the United States flag with the British flag for the English language icon
Changed the UI for download progress on resource packs to be more clear


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if no one voted for a map
Fixed resource packs duplicating if you selected the default one
Players can no longer kill you from different matches
Fixed a bug where pressing the equals key would open a "Network Stream" window
Resource packs will no longer load if you try to join a private match and type the "s" key as the password and then press enter
Fixed the italian translation for "Create"
Made gondolas slightly less janky by increasing the sync time from 0.5s to 4s
You will no longer respawn if you enter spectator mode while respawning
Fixed a bug where if destroyable walls were destroyed on a map, loading the map would play a horrible sound
Network optimizations
Fixed SteamWarningAPI and MemoryManagement errors
Invisible players should (potentially) be fixed, as failed connections now automatically attempt to re-establish themselves instead of just permanently disconnecting


Minor Releases

1.23.1 (August 1)

Fixed a bug where some audio on XEO was not affected by the volume slider
You can now join friends through Steam even if you're already in a match
Discord invites are now supported (not the "Ask to Join" button though)
Added a "Time played" line to Discord rich presence


1.23.2 (August 1)

Fixed a bug with joining a private match through Steam or Discord

notes.title: Update 1.21
notes.notes:
Changes

Hosts can now ban players. Open the scoreboard, press middle mouse button to free the cursor, click on the player you want to ban, and click "Ban." This will prevent the player from participating in that match. You can also report hackers and view player profiles from this screen. Please report hackers in-game and on the discord server for them to be banned from the entire game.
Added profile pictures to the scoreboard
Added a new setting which lets you disable profile pictures
Made grapple aim-assist more forgiving

notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/361d86772657262896f89eb2327e6979cb64abae.png

Changes

Added 4 new hats, 3 of which can be purchased on the Item Store. The Santa Hat is free to keep forever if you play the game before January 1st!
Added flying gondolas to Ruins, Arena, and Skyway
Added leaderboards
Added new keybinds: Next Weapon and Previous Weapon
Added control prompts when interacting with things such as the upgrade machine, so you know what keys you need to press
Reworked the in-match UI to be cleaner and smaller
You can now see which match your friends are in on the find match menu by looking for the green icon on matches
Steam friends will now have green names in-game


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug where audio would play loudly when leaving a match
Completely removed controller support due to a variety of issues. If you want to play the game on a controller, please remap your controller to the keyboard through Steam Input.

notes.title: Update 1.19
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/bac2c652093381d9056c60e0a72edfdeec0450b8.gif

Changes

Added a Gravity room setting. You can reverse it if you want :)
Added a Spawn Mode room setting with three options: calm, hectic, and mayhem. Calm will spawn you as far away from other players as possible, hectic will spawn you as close to other players as possible, and mayhem will spawn all players at the same spawnpoint.
You will now spawn with your last equipped item
Added text to show who you are spectating


Bugfixes

Increased the volume of the melee sound effects
If the player you are spectating dies, you will spectate another random player
Fixed some issues with the quality settings not reflecting the correct quality

notes.title: Update 1.18
notes.notes:
Changes

Added a melee attack, the default keybind is V. It deals 50 damage.
Added a Melee Kills statistic
Reduced the minimum mouse sensitivity


Bugfixes

Fixed the lag in the main menu
Fixed an issue where the "You got Killed" message would block access to the escape menu

notes.title: Update 1.17
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/0f71bf7523cc57b93d0659dfaaae019a753a5086.gif

Changes

Added Time Trials! There are currently 4 and you can find the starting points on the maps Streets, Metro, Shapes, and Arena
Added a keybind to restart the current time trial
Added Time Trial Ghosts which you can enable in the settings menu for yourself, the top player for the time trial, a Steam friend, or another player's Steam ID
Increased zoom on the sniper when using the red dot or reflex sight


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug where having a resource pack equipped with an empty menu_music folder would prevent you from getting exp (sorry KamiEp!x)
Removed achievements that relied on explosive barrels which were removed in a previous update
Simplified the fullscreen options
Translated the quality and fullscreen settings
Fixed some missing characters for Japanese


Thanks to u/rakalakalili on Reddit for helping me iron out the replay system :)

notes.title: Update 1.16
notes.notes:
Changes

Added a Player Size room setting
Added spectator mode ( /spectate )
Improved the level UI in the main menu
Added a command to kill yourself ( /die )

Bugfixes

Improved loading time for joining a room

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.notes:
Changes

Added room settings for rifle, shotgun, and sniper damage multipliers
Added a room setting to enable/disable upgrade cabinets
Added a setting to toggle damage popups and change their size
Increased maximum match time to 60 minutes
Added an option to disable camera locking, which lets you spin your head 360 degrees vertically (super disorienting)
Added a keyboard input to sliders
Added a notification to matches if they are running a different version than you
Players in matches you join will now be on Steam's "Recently Played With" list
Added new resource pack options

Bugfixes

Fixed keybinds not saving
Translated keybind names
Fixed some UI issues

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.notes:
Changes

You can now rebind movement keys in the Settings menu (default is WASD)
You can now see the creator of a match's steam id by hovering over it in the match list
Your own name will now appear orange in the killfeed

Bugfixes

Patched an EXP farming exploit

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.notes:
Hey all! I've added Resource Packs, which change the visuals and audio of the game. You can get ones you like from the Steam Workshop by subscribing to them, and then equipping them in-game through the  Resource Pack menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507759/cd94c627638e4e9d793275c89c7fea0c4a28fe16.png
Click here to get this resource pack on the Steam Workshop

I'm still working on making a tutorial on how to create your own, but for now you can join the discord server to get help and use this short documentation for a guide.

Changes

Added Resource Packs - accessible from the main menu by clicking the "Mods" button


Bugfixes

Fixed invincible players randomly spawning around the map
Bullet visuals will no travel in the proper direction for the local player
Fixed the bug where damage indicator numbers would point the wrong way on Orbit

notes.title: Update 1.12.2
notes.notes:
Added the Jack-o'-Lantern hat! This hat will be given permanently to all players who play from now until a week after Halloween.

Changes

Removed the ping in the match list as it wasn't actually an accurate representation of your connection to other players (Redmatch 2 has distributed connections instead of a central host)
Removed the Meet the Maker achievement
Added the Betrayal achievement

notes.title: Update 1.11.0
notes.notes:
Changes

Added Japanese
Added full Unicode support for usernames and chat
Added an invite friends button
Improved performance of match list in main menu
Improved visibility at long range with the damage number indicators
Destroyed walls will now correctly be destroyed for late joiners

Bugfixes

Actually fixed the bug where progress achievements would revert to 0 on game restart
Fixed a bug where all barrels would say killed by the host
Fixed a bug where you would not return to the lobby, and the game would just instantly restart on the same map

notes.title: Update 1.10.0
notes.notes:
Changes

Re-added Barrelpocalypse
Re-added StickyGoGos
Added the Traffic Cone hat to the Fashionable Attire DLC
Improved support for non-english usernames
You can now put spaces in match names
You can now see full matches in the lobby list
You can now join your friends' matches from your steam friends list
Added a timeout for when joining a match fails, so that instead of getting stuck in an endless loading screen you are returned to the menu

Bugfixes

Achievements that require a win will no longer be unlocked even if you didn't win
Damage popups now work correctly with the damage multiplier
Fixed error where achievement completion progress would not save for World Trip, Workplace Catastrophe, and Learning the ABCs after restarting the game
Fixed the bug where matches would have insanely long times (135838756718358 or whatever)
The photosensitive warning will no longer sometimes display after leaving a match

notes.title: Update 1.9.1
notes.notes:
Changes

Added damage indicators
Added a long-overdue custom healthbar for the Pixel death effect
Added steam friends list grouping so you can see which of your friends are playing Redmatch 2 together

Bugfixes

Fixed gun audio not playing for other players

notes.title: Update 1.9.0
notes.notes:
Changes

Added the Fashionable Attire DLC which contains 5 hats, including a Propeller hat, Top hat, Halo, Googly eyes, and Horns. The Horns hat grows whenever you get a kill!
Added language support for Italian, Swedish, Danish, Greek, Portuguese, Bulgarian, and more
Redesigned find match menu
Animations will now sync (reloading, aiming down sights)
Added flags to the languages cuz it looks pretty
Instead of figuring out how to fix the infinite match bug, it now just says "Infinite" when the match goes infinite. Whatever, at least it's not ugly now
Increased the maximum player count for matches from 20 to 50

Bugfixes

Fixed some issues with missing characters in localized languages
Fixed bug where the screen would turn black when respawning
Fixed the orientation of the Determination death effect in the main menu

notes.title: Update 1.8.4
notes.notes:
Changes

Removed the AFK timer
Redesigned the scoreboard UI
Added more spawnpoints
Completely removed the old account system. Everything is now dependent on Steam, and your in-game username is just your Steam username.
Finished switching networking solutions, which means reduced latency across the board.
Added pings to matches so you can see the latency to the host before joining

Bugfixes

Custom skins will now save between rounds and game restarts
Fixed an issue where you could not leave the computer terminal


Since it's a new networking solution, you can expect quite a few bugs. Please tell me if you find any so I can fix them ASAP.

Also, hats are in the works! You can check out the progress so far on the Redmatch 2 discord server.

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1
notes.notes:
Changes

 Added refresh rates to the resolution dropdown, so you can play at 144fps
 Added loading screens with art by NikART

Bugfixes

 Fixed the World Trip achievement breaking after adding Orbit
 Fixed the Learning the ABCs achievement not working on usernames that didn't start with an english letter
 Fixed players being able to use blank names

notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Changes

Added a new map, Orbit
Added language support. Pick the language you want to play in from the main menu. It will default to the language steam is running in. There are 11 languages so far, but more are planned for future updates
Removed the old account system. You no longer need to sign up to track stats or earn experience
Optimized the networking code a ton. You should see much less latency when killing players and moving around
Added a physics tickrate setting, which will make the game feel a lot smoother at the cost of performance. A map reload is required for it to take effect
Re-added chat
Added Steam Chat Filtering, which means you now control the chat filter level through your steam account
Added a controller detection notice since far too many people were asking me why their player was looking up at the sky

Bugfixes

Fixed the First Aid achievement not working
Unlocked hidden achievements will now show the proper unlocked icon
Fixed some lighting errors on the map Village


StickyGoGos, Barrels, and Ammo Pickups will return in a future update. I'm still working on optimizing them properly, because the hundreds at a time before put a huge strain on the servers.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.5
notes.notes:
Chat is temporarily disabled until I fix it.

Changes

 Added Invert Y
 Added a player count slider for creating matches
 Rebound console to Ctrl + ` instead of just `
 Covered the bottom of Ruins
 ODM Gear is now enabled by default


Bugfixes

 Improved player interpolation, so they should not be zipping about now when spawning in, and you shouldn't randomly get launched when spawning on top of someone else
 Patched an exploit which let cheaters disconnect other players
 Filled the floor holes on Village
 The Think, Mark! Achievement will no longer unlock if you buy the upgrades split up between separate matches, and now requires you to upgrade them all in the same match (which was the original intention)
 You can no longer use special characters in room names
 Failing to join a match will no longer get you stuck in an endless loading loop
 Sacrificed visual accuracy for network performance yet again because the servers are getting overloaded
 The match timer can now go... negative? So at least you can know how long the match has been bugged out for.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.4
notes.notes:
The Blood Red DLC is now available on Steam! It's a cosmetic skin and death effect pack you can buy for $2.99.

Changes

 Private match creation is now available to all players
 Reduced the distance for the 1 in 7.5 Trillion achievement from 100 meters to 75
 You can now view what items you are missing on the Learning the ABCs and World Trip achievements by hovering over them in the achievement menu

Bugfixes

 First Aid achievement was not working
 StickyGoGos will no longer grant the Just a Flesh Wound achievement
 Trades will now count as kills for both players
 Added a shadow to the corrupt death effect
 Leaving a room with a countdown will no longer trigger a loading screen when the countdown completes after you have left the room
 Attempted to fix a bug where the Meet the Maker achievement would sometimes not fire. We'll see, I guess.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Following the release yesterday we found a ton of new bugs. I've fixed quite a few, but if you find any more be sure to submit them in the #bug-reports channel of our Discord Server!

If you don't see the update, make sure to exit Steam (not just close it) and restart it.

Changes

 Reduced StickyGoGo explosion force

Bugfixes

 Getting a kill as a guest will now show up on the leaderboard
 Collateral achievement was not working
 Tis But a Scratch achievement would be given if you killed a player after you died
 Shortlived Victory achievement gave you the achievement if you killed someone after dying, instead of dying after killing someone
 Jack of All Trades achievement was not working
 Players would sometimes get a question mark as their kill and it would not count in rooms that had been active for a long time
 Upgrade cabinets would not play audio
 Upgrade cabinets would let you upgrade infinitely and would not display your current upgrade amount
